paragraphs: TravelAI is a modern, full-stack web platform that synthesizes bespoke, day-by-day travel itineraries in seconds. By pairing Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and high-speed Groq fallbacks with interactive maps, financial analytics, and multi-night stay deduplication, TravelAI transforms travel planning from hours of frustrating research into an effortless, personalized experience.
features: Primary Model: Powered by Google's latest Gemini 2.5 Flash for rapid reasoning and multimodal world knowledge.
Instant Fallback: Automatic failover to ultra-low-latency Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b / qwen/qwen3.8-27b) upon rate limits (429) or API disruptions.
Live SSE Streaming: Multi-stage progress indicators keeping users engaged while the itinerary synthesizes in real time.
Destination Discovery: Search bar with auto-suggestions and trending Indian hotspots (Goa, Manali, Wayanad, Jaipur, Ladakh, etc.).
Smart Calendar: Departure/return pickers with duration presets (Weekend Getaway, 5-Day Recharge, 1-Week Vacation).
